tax_name: Mehrwertsteuer (MWST) / Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée (TVA)
legal_ref: MWSTG (SR 641.20) Art. 25 Abs. 1, Fassung gemäss V vom 9. Dez. 2022 (AS 2022 863)
quote: Die Steuer beträgt 8,1 Prozent (Normalsatz); vorbehalten bleiben die Absätze 2 und 3. [Fn: Fassung gemäss Ziff. I der V vom 9. Dez. 2022 über die Anhebung der Mehrwertsteuersätze zur Zusatzfinanzierung der AHV, in Kraft seit 1. Jan. 2024] — The tax is 8.1 percent (standard rate), in force since 1 Jan 2024.
source_title: Fedlex — Bundesgesetz über die Mehrwertsteuer (MWSTG), SR 641.20, Stand 1.1.2025, Art. 25; cross-checked ESTV 'MWST-Steuersätze' page (estv.admin.ch, updated 22.09.2026)

reduced_rates.scope: food (not restaurant), water in pipes, medicines, books/newspapers incl. electronic, menstrual hygiene products, agricultural inputs, radio/TV services (Art. 25 Abs. 2)
accommodation incl. breakfast (special rate, Art. 25 Abs. 4; valid until 31 Dec 2027 at the latest)

notes: Special accommodation rate 3.8% runs until 31.12.2027 at the latest (Art. 25 Abs. 4 / Art. 196 Ziff. 14 BV). Pending, NOT enacted: Parliament's federal decree (constitutional amendment) raising VAT by 0.4 percentage points to finance the 13th AHV pension — subject to the mandatory popular vote scheduled for 29 November 2026 (parlament.ch SGK press release 17.06.2026); not listed as a future change because not yet adopted. Same rates apply in Liechtenstein (customs union). Exempt from liability below CHF 100,000 annual turnover in Switzerland and abroad (MWSTG Art. 10 Abs. 2 lit. a).
